title: apps/localtoolbox
description: Issues for the localtoolbox Chrome extension
readme: Open issues labelled localtoolbox or "localtoolbox: <area>", kept in step by tools/project.sh with the Local Network project (https://github.com/orgs/cutenode/projects/9): Status is the same on both, and Area comes from the area labels. How the fields are used: https://github.com/cutenode/localnetwork/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md#issues-and-the-project
